Caméra frontale et piste élargie adaptées au jeu ; panneaux et formes des sièges simplifiés. Pas de fidélité 1:1 certifiée.

initialOutput.reason: Seating arrangement reversed relative to the official preview.

revisions.prompt: Edit ONLY the seating arrangement in the first supplied empty office background. The second image is the official reference for who sits on which side of the desk. The current drawing reverses this arrangement. Correct it as follows: remove the current three chairs; put the ONE larger sharply pointed executive chair on the CAMERA/near side of the desk, centered slightly left, viewed from BEHIND and facing toward the desk and back wall; put the TWO smaller visitor chairs on the FAR side of the desk, facing toward the camera, their upper backs visible behind the tabletop. Match this side relationship to the official preview. Keep the scene EMPTY, no people. Preserve the same grand cyan V on the back wall, desk shape, architecture, side aquarium frames, coral silhouettes, blue/cyan palette, 16:9 canvas, lighting and clean free floor. Keep all three chairs and the desk within the rear two thirds so the lower third remains a continuous empty playing surface. Do not add text, card borders, glitter, another desk, a fourth chair, props, characters, UI or animation. This is one complete opaque static environment image.
